# `delegated_projects` — version 2.0

Source: `presets/delegated-projects.satz`

## Purpose

The ready-made delegation pack for projects: the Google projects a delegation's account
works in, and its roles on those projects alone. It stands in the organization's estate,
which creates each project and keeps it in its state; the workload estate, in its own
repository, builds inside it as that account, with a workload pack of its own. The account is the base's
(`presets/delegation.satz`): each entry here names the delegation whose account works in
the project.

ONE LIST. One entry of `delegated_projects`,
{ name = "payments"      delegation = "payments" }
{ name = "shop-backend"  delegation = "shop" }
{ name = "shop-frontend" delegation = "shop" }
is one Google project `{customer_shortname}-<name>-001`. One account works in as many
projects as name its delegation. The grant names the account by reference, so an entry
that names a delegation no entry of `delegations` declares is refused by the transpile,
which lists the accounts that exist. Entries are bound in the estate, added with
`satz add-entry`, or requested by the team as `contributes_delegated_projects`.

WHAT AN ACCOUNT HOLDS ON ITS PROJECT. `delegated_projects_roles` — the project's IAM and
its services — on that project and nowhere else: it creates no project and reaches none
beside its own. What its estate's resource types need beyond that it grants its own
account in its estate, on the project (`google_project_iam_member`, which the interface
allows). `budgets = true` adds the organization's budget role on the project
(`presets/delegated-budget-role.satz`).

THE PROJECT. Billed to the infrastructure billing account and created in
`delegated_projects_folder`: the workload folder, `google_folder.workload_folder.name`,
unless the estate names another folder it declares or one that already exists. Its `apis` are
the five below unless the entry states its own list, whole. The team's CALLS are billed
to the delegation's infrastructure project, not to this one: an API a call needs is
asked for in the delegation's entry.

WHAT THE WORKLOAD ESTATE READS. The interface `<name>`, taken beside the delegation's own:
`project_id` (an attach point for `google_project_iam_member`), `project_number`,
`delegated_project_roles` and `delegated_budgets`, which tell the workload's team what the
account holds — satz checks no role in a workload estate. One estate reads one project's
interface: an account that works in two
projects is worked in by two estates that run as the same estate account. A project's name is
an interface's name: no folder of `presets/delegated-folders.satz` may carry the same.

MORE IN AN INTERFACE. An interface declared in two files is one interface, so the estate
adds to a project's interface by writing a block of the same name in its own file:
`interface "payments" { use interface "network" }`.

NO CLAIM. A delegated project is a workload's, not a control: this pack witnesses nothing.

## Use it

```
params {
  use_delegated_projects = true

  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  delegated_projects = []
  delegated_projects_folder = "google_folder.workload_folder.name"
  delegated_projects_roles = [
    "roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin",
    "roles/serviceusage.serviceUsageAdmin",
  ]
}

use "presets/delegated-projects.satz" when use_delegated_projects
```

`use_delegated_projects` is the gate: while it is falsy the pack contributes nothing — no resources, no params, no claims. It is declared by `estate_map`, and the estate's own binding wins.

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `billing_account_infra` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `customer_shortname` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Params

| param | default |
|---|---|

| `delegated_projects_folder` | `"google_folder.workload_folder.name"` |
| `delegated_projects_roles` | `[ "roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin", "roles/serviceusage.serviceUsageAdmin" ]` |

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delegated_projects_folder` | The folder the delegated projects are created in — the workload folder as `google_folder.workload_folder.name`, another folder the estate declares as `google_folder.<label>.name`, or an existing one by its numeric id | edit | low | — |

**delegated_projects_folder** — It decides the policies and the grants every project inherits. Changing it afterwards moves every live project between parents.


## Contributes

| resource type | labels |
|---|---|
| `google_project` | `one per entry of delegated_projects, by name` |
| `google_project_iam_member` | `one per entry of delegated_projects, by name`, `one per entry of delegated_projects, by name` |

## Exports

Outputs of the HCL code and values of the interfaces under `interfaces/outgoing/` in every estate that uses this pack: a `core` export is carried by every interface, another one by its own interface and every interface that uses it. An interface a pack declares is common: every project's folder carries it.

| interface | output | value | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{each.name}` | `project_id` | `"${google_project.{each.name}.project_id}"` | The project's Google project — attach point for `google_project_iam_member` |
| `{each.name}` | `project_number` | `"${google_project.{each.name}.number}"` | Its number, looked up |
| `{each.name}` | `delegated_project_roles` | `delegated_projects_roles` | The roles the delegation's account holds on the project |
| `{each.name}` | `delegated_budgets` | `each.budgets` | Whether the account may manage budgets for this project |

`{each.name}` is written once per entry of `delegated_projects`, named by the entry's `name`, and each is one project's own interface, not a common one.

## List params

What a project may add to this pack's lists, through `contributes_<param>` in a file the estate uses after a reviewed pull request; `satz check-request` checks such a file.

| list | key | fields | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delegated_projects` | `name` | `name` matching `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, `delegation` matching `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, `apis`, `budgets` | A project a delegation's account works in: its name, which is its interface's, the delegation's name, the APIs enabled on it, and whether a budget is delegated for it |

_None — this pack proves no control by itself._

## History

| version | date | change |
|---|---|---|
| 2.0 | 2026-11-19 | `delegated_projects_folder` defaults to the workload folder, `google_folder.workload_folder.name`, where it was empty, the organization: a project of an estate that did not bind it moves into the workload folder, in place; another parent is still named by binding it. The list is declared with `entries` where it said `request` (ADR 0096; BREAKING, see Breaking changes) |
| 1.0 | 2026-11-19 | first version, replacing `project_workload`: one list, `delegated_projects`, each entry naming the `delegation` whose account works in the project; a project has no account, state bucket or group of its own, and the team's calls are billed to the delegation's infrastructure project (ADR 0093) |
